name: Astribot S1
summary: S1 is a wheeled humanoid upper body with two 7-DoF arms on a mobile base, built by Shenzhen's Stardust Intelligence. It is designed for fast, precise arm motion and AI learning, and is used in retail and service settings in China.
highlights: End-effector speed of 10 m/s or more and repeatability of +/-0.1 mm, per Astribot.
Each arm has 7 DoF; arm span is 194 cm.
Customers include JD.com and ThunderSoft; Robot MART stores operate in six Chinese cities, per BigGo Finance.
caveats: Wheeled base, not a legged humanoid.
No official price; reseller estimates vary widely.

sources.title: China's Astribot Raises Fourth Round in Six Months, Valuation Jumps to 15 Billion Yuan
